evaluation_rules: Freeze estimator and features before evaluation; no tuning on validation or holdout outcomes.
Only exact-line pregame receipts after model availability; outcomes must be verified and recorded after game start.
Keep validation and holdout disjoint by event and chronological period.
Report Brier and log loss against contemporaneous paired baselines, calibration, sample sizes, and event dependence.
Missing baselines, insufficient samples or provenance leave evaluation incomplete. Do not extend windows after seeing outcomes.
No model promotion: existing sport-policy, calibration, uncertainty, exposure and live eligibility gates must still pass.
This development artifact is not a loadable production/challenger bundle; formal evaluator must verify plan and estimator hashes.
